name: Huge Spider Solitaire
author: Addicting Games
description: Huge Spider Solitaire is a card game but with two stacks of cards! If you love solitaire but want more of a challenge, try out the spider version. Maybe spiders aren’t your thing but do not fret! While there is a creepy name, this card game is similar to the game you love but with two decks and a few additional rules. Move around the cards to create a column with cards from King to Ace of the same suit. Complete this with all of the cards to win in this online game. Click on the deck when you run out of moves, and try to win as many games as possible. The game is not timed, but the faster you go the better your score!
